description:
Sweescape is an all-in-one event management suite for organizers — ticketing, badges, check-in, analytics, and audience campaigns. This connector lets you run your own Sweescape workspace directly from ChatGPT.

Ask ChatGPT to look up your events, ticket types and sales, attendance and analytics, and to list your audiences and automations. You can also draft newticketing pages, automations, and email or SMS campaigns — all inside your own workspace.

Everything stays a draft: the connector can prepare and edit content, but publishing a page, activating an automation, or sending a campaign always remains a manual action you take inside Sweescape. It is a first-party connector that accesses only your own Sweescape data.
